headings.rules: NEVER use Inter or generic sans for headings. Apply kinetic, masked line-by-line reveal for hero.

colors.rules: Strict Dark Mode (Electric & Neon / Luxury hybrid). No muddy greys. High-contrast white text. Use #050505 for main background to give infinite depth. Accent colors used extremely sparingly for interaction highlights.

surfaces.style: Crystal Glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-2xl bg-black/60 with 1px border-white/10 bottom border. CRITICAL: DO NOT use complete transparent backgrounds for dropdowns; use solid dark bg (bg-zinc-950) if blur isn't enough.
Neo-brutalist tech borders: bg-white/[0.02] border border-white/10 hover:border-white/30 transition-colors duration-300. Layered ambient shadows.

motion.behavior: Masked line-by-line reveal. Wrap individual lines in overflow-hidden divs, animate text from y: '100%' to 0 with custom ease [0.19, 1, 0.22, 1].
Extremely slow, relentless editorial drift. High contrast, large outline text (text-transparent stroke-white).
Subtle y-axis translation for background elements as the user scrolls.

layouts.hero: Full-bleed, 100vh. Kinetic typography over a deep, dark abstract background. Top-right 'Start a conversation' button.
layouts.approach_manifesto: Numbered chapters ('Two disciplines. One engagement.'). Vertical editorial layout. Use text-8xl watermark numbers (text-white/5) positioned absolutely behind the main text.
layouts.core_capabilities: Bento Grid Protocol Mode A (Tetris Grid). Asymmetrical spans (col-span-12 md:col-span-8 vs col-span-4). Wide gap-8.
layouts.footer: Massive py-32 padding. Multi-column grid. Giant brand logo or 'Start a conversation' CTA text (text-[10vw]) at the very bottom.

components.name: Navigation
components.instructions: Sticky nav with hover dropdown menus. Desktop must show full links. Accessible via keyboard. High contrast dropdown backgrounds (e.g., bg-zinc-950 border border-zinc-800).

components.name: NewsAdmin
components.instructions: Dashboard interface for CMS. Strict grid hierarchy, flat surfaces, sharp edges, tight gaps. Include image upload functionality.

accessibility.contrast: APCA & WCAG AA minimum 4.5:1. Never use dark text on dark backgrounds.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='hero-cta-button').

image_urls.description: Abstract futuristic cyber landscape with digital matrix
Close-up of server racks in a data center
Colleagues engage in a lively discussion during a team meeting

media.rules: Max mobile height 80vh. Use bg-black/50 minimum overlay on hero images to maintain absolute text contrast.

3d_libraries.instructions: Prioritize framer-motion for the parallax/3D hero moment using scroll-linked 3D transforms (rotateX/rotateY). Avoid heavy WebGL unless specifically modeling a 3D asset.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Install and use '@studio-freight/react-lenis' for smooth momentum scrolling.
Install and use 'framer-motion' for all kinetic reveals and micro-interactions.
Avoid generic 'AI slop' design. Ensure high visual tension, extreme typography contrast, and editorial asymmetry.
Do not center-align everything; use explicit left-alignment for modern editorial feel.
Always apply hover, active, and focus states.
CRITICAL: Do NOT use complete transparent backgrounds for UI overlays or dropdowns. Solidify backgrounds if they hover over text.
Use data-testid on all interactive and informational elements (buttons, links, forms, tabs).
Ensure the hero is an Awwwards-level kinetic text reveal (staggered line by line, overflowing hidden containers).
GENERAL UI UX DESIGN GUIDELINES: Layouts must respond flawlessly down to mobile (320px). Use fluid typography scaling for oversized text.
You have .js files not .tsx file, so generate JSX inside .js files.
